job_statement: When I need to tune OpenShift Pipelines for my organization's requirements, I want to customize the TektonConfig CR, so I can control behavior, resource limits, and feature availability cluster-wide
related_jobs: Monitor pipeline performance; Set resource quotas
desired_outcomes: Ensure pipelines match organizational policies; Optimize resource usage; Enable required features
notes: Core configuration management for cluster-wide pipeline settings

job_statement: When I need to control what pipelines can access by default, I want to change the default service account for pipeline runs, so I can enforce appropriate permissions without modifying individual pipelines
prerequisites: Service account with desired permissions created
related_jobs: Configure RBAC for pipelines; Manage secrets access
desired_outcomes: Ensure least-privilege access; Simplify pipeline definitions; Maintain security standards

job_statement: When I want to enable remote task and pipeline resolution, I want to configure resolvers in TektonConfig, so developers can reference tasks from Git repositories, Tekton Hub, or other clusters
related_jobs: Configure Tekton Hub; Set up Git authentication
desired_outcomes: Enable task reuse from external sources; Simplify pipeline definitions; Reduce duplication

job_statement: When I need to optimize pipeline execution performance, I want to configure options like disable affinity assistant, so I can improve scheduling and resource utilization for my workloads
related_jobs: Monitor pipeline performance; Tune resource limits
desired_outcomes: Reduce pipeline execution time; Improve cluster resource utilization; Minimize scheduling conflicts

job_statement: When I need to prevent resource exhaustion, I want to set limits on pipeline size and execution time, so I can protect cluster stability and enforce organizational policies
related_jobs: Set resource quotas; Monitor pipeline execution
desired_outcomes: Prevent runaway pipelines; Ensure fair resource distribution; Enforce pipeline design standards

job_statement: When I want to enable GitOps-style pipeline management, I want to configure Pipelines as Code settings in TektonConfig, so developers can define and trigger pipelines directly from their Git repositories
related_jobs: Configure Git webhooks; Set up Git authentication
desired_outcomes: Enable Git-driven pipeline execution; Simplify pipeline lifecycle management; Improve developer experience

job_statement: When I need supply chain security for my pipelines, I want to enable and configure Tekton Chains, so I can generate signed attestations for pipeline runs and verify artifact provenance
related_jobs: Configure signing keys; Set up artifact storage
desired_outcomes: Ensure artifact authenticity; Meet supply chain security requirements; Enable provenance verification
